WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY transref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages
), kept AS (
  SELECT ta.transref, ta.avg_anlycount, o.overall_avg
  FROM transaction_averages AS ta
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ta.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg
), kept_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg
  FROM kept
)
SELECT k.transref,
       k.avg_anlycount,
       k.avg_anlycount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
       k.avg_anlycount - ka.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS ka
ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
